SHOW CAUSE NOTICE UNDER SECTION 73 OF THE CGST ACT 2017
Notice Ref: SCN/MH/2023/1313 Dated 25-10-2023
GSTIN: 27WWWXX9012W1Z8 M/s Western Auto Components
FY: 2018-19

1. Officer proposes disallowance of ITC of Rs. 3,20,000/- for FY 2018-19 alleging delayed filing of GSTR-3B after 20th October 2019 under Section 16(4).
2. Taxpayer points out return GSTR-3B was filed on 15th November 2020 before 30th November 2021 cut-off, which is explicitly protected by retrospective statutory relaxation under Section 16(5).
